video.title: How England Beat Netherlands, Zirkzee To Man United & More! | Monday Vibes
video.description:
Welcome back to Monday Vibes where today we are analysing England's penalty shootout triumph against Switzerland, which was inspired by Arsenal's Bukayo Saka scoring a beautiful goal and then stepping up to slot home a penalty.

Who stepped up for Gareth Southgate's England side? What sort of threat do Netherlands pose? And who will triumph?

As if that wasn't enough we also reflect on Spain's 2-1 victory over Germany and France's dull win over Portugal which was decided on penalties, including our thoughts on Kylian Mbappe's struggles!

Enjoy the video? Remember to like it, leave a comment and subscribe to the channel for more great content!
